title: seq events
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack's step fire as events, so several mods that change what the sequencer plays combine: generators (does a step fire; the step it reads) and effects over what every build plays, audio and MIDI tracks (the trig, its condition, a MIDI track's notes and velocity, an audio track's locks), a step clock per track, and the playing pattern's facts when asked (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Step-fire events"). The same names as the Digitone's and the Digitakt's. On its own it changes nothing the unit does.
